title: taito.ai clone — PageSpec
description: The machine contract for a generated page composition. Structural validity (closed enums, required fields, additionalProperties:false) is enforced here. Per-section-type content-field validation, template<->node cross-referencing, rhythm rules, and maxWords are enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py, which JSON Schema alone cannot express — see BUILD-GUIDE.md 2.5/2.7.

$comment.description: Optional, documentation-only, standard JSON Schema convention — never enforced or read by semantic_validate.py.

pageSpecVersion.description: Documentation-only version marker. NOT machine-checked against anything (see registry.manifest.json versionFieldNote).

route.description: The real or intended route path this PageSpec composes a page for, e.g. '/', '/founders', '/blog/some-post-slug', or the literal '*' for template.not-found's real wildcard route (src/App.jsx's catch-all Route path="*").

template.description: Closed enum, one of the 20 real template ids in templates/templates.json. semantic_validate.py cross-references this against that template's own real node list — a PageSpec's nodes[] must not just be independently valid, it must actually match its declared template's shape (BUILD-GUIDE.md 2.7, the single most-repeated bug class per MASTER-GUIDE.md 3.3).

section.description: Closed enum of the 44 real section ids defined under sections/. No invented section id can pass schema validation.

content.description: Section-type-specific content fields. Structurally open here at the JSON Schema layer (each of the 44 section types has a genuinely different field shape — see sections/*.json for each one's real content contract) but CLOSED and per-field-validated by semantic_validate.py, which loads the matching sections/<id>.json contract and rejects any field not declared there, any missing required field, and any maxWords overflow. This is the schema/validator split BUILD-GUIDE.md 2.7 describes, not a gap — additionalProperties:false at the JSON-Schema layer for 44 independently-shaped content objects would require 44 oneOf branches with zero shared structure, which the semantic validator already does more precisely (it reads the real section contract file, not a duplicated copy of it).

pattern.description: One id (or array of ids, for sections with multiple concurrent patterns) from tokens/00-foundation/motion.json's siteWideInventory. Closed set — semantic_validate.py rejects any pattern id not in that inventory.

trigger.description: Closed enum of real trigger types observed site-wide (CLONE_SPEC.md §17). No scroll-triggered section reveals or parallax exist on the real site — 'scroll-intersection' here refers only to the documented IntersectionObserver-gated patterns (e.g. agent-stepper-advance), never a generic scroll-reveal.

reducedMotionFallback.description: REQUIRED on every node, no exceptions. Every real animation on the site has a documented reduced-motion branch (CLONE_SPEC.md:14) — a PageSpec node with motion but no fallback description is rejected.

motion.description: Closed to real, evidence-grounded fields only (additionalProperties:false) — a generated PageSpec cannot smuggle in an invented motion field, per MASTER-GUIDE.md 3.7's Craft lesson.
